verses.text: Now I no want make una no know, brothers, say our papa dem all dey under di cloud, and all pass through di sea;
and all dem baptize into Moses for di cloud and for di sea;
and all chop di same spiritual food;
and all drink di same spiritual drink. Because dem drink from spiritual rock wey follow dem, and di rock na Christ.
Still with most of dem, God no please well, because dem destroy dem for di wilderness.
Now these things na our examples, so that we no go lust after evil things as dem lust too.
No be idolaters, as some of dem be. As e dey write, “Di people sit down to chop and drink, and get up to play.”
Make we no commit sexual immorality, as some of dem commit, and for one day 23,000 fall.
Make we no test di Lord, as some of dem test, and snakes kill dem.
No grumble, as some of dem grumble too, and di destroyer kill dem.
Now all these things happen to dem as example, and dem write dem as warning for us, on whom di ends of di ages don reach.
So make di one wey think say e dey stand dey careful say e no go fall.

No temptation don catch una except wetin common to man. God dey faithful, wey no go allow dem tempt una pass wetin una fit bear, but go make way of escape with di temptation too, so that una go fit endure am.
So, my beloved, run from idolatry.
I dey talk as to wise men. Judge wetin I talk.
Di cup of blessing wey we dey bless, no be sharing of di blood of Christ? Di bread wey we dey break, no be sharing of di body of Christ?
Because one bread dey, we, wey plenty, na one body; because we all dey share di one bread.
Consider Israel according to di flesh. No be di people wey dey chop di sacrifices dey share di altar?
Wetin I dey talk den? Say thing wey dem sacrifice to idols na anything, or say idol na anything?
But I talk say di things wey di Gentiles dey sacrifice, dem dey sacrifice dem to evil spirits, no be to God, and I no want make una get fellowship with evil spirits.
Una no fit drink both di cup of di Lord and di cup of evil spirits. Una no fit share both di table of di Lord, and di table of evil spirits.
Or we dey provoke di Lord to jealousy? We strong pass am?
“All things dey lawful for me,” but no be all things dey profitable. “All things dey lawful for me,” but no be all things dey build up.
Make nobody seek im own, but each one im neighbor good.
Whatever dem dey sell for di meat market, chop am, no ask any question for conscience sake,
because “di earth na di Lord own, and im fullness.”
But if one of di people wey no believe invite una to meal, and una wan go, chop whatever dem put before una, no ask any question for conscience sake.
But if anybody talk to una, “This one dem offer to idols,” no chop am for di sake of di one wey tell una, and for conscience sake. Because “di earth na di Lord own, with all im fullness.”
Conscience, I talk, no be your own, but di other person own; because why another person conscience go judge my liberty?
If I share with thankfulness, why dem dey denounce me for something wey I dey thank God for?
So whether una chop, or drink, or whatever una do, do all to give God glory.
No give occasions for stumbling, whether to Jews, or to Greeks, or to di assembly of God;
even as I dey please all men for all things too, no dey seek my own profit, but di profit of di many, so that dem go dey saved.
Imitate me, even as I dey imitate Christ too.
Now I praise una, brothers, say una dey remember me for all things, and hold di traditions firm, even as I deliver dem to una.
But I want make una know say di head of every man na Christ, and di head of di woman na man, and di head of Christ na God.
Every man wey dey pray or prophesy, as im head dey covered, dey dishonor im head.
But every woman wey dey pray or prophesy with im head uncovered dey dishonor im head, because e be one and di same as if dem shave am.
Because if woman no cover, make dem cut im hair too; but if e shameful for woman to cut hair or shave, make e cover.
Because man suppose no cover im head, because e be di image and glory of God, but di woman na di glory of di man.
Because man no come from woman, but woman from man;
because dem no create man for di woman, but woman for di man.
For this reason di woman suppose get authority on im head, because of di angels.
Still, neither di woman dey independent of di man, nor di man dey independent of di woman, for di Lord.
Because as di woman come from di man, so di man dey through di woman too; but all things come from God.
Judge for yourselves. E appropriate say woman go pray to God without cover?
Even nature imself no dey teach una say if man get long hair, e dey dishonor am?
But if woman get long hair, e dey glory to am, because dem give am hair for covering.
But if any man seem like say e wan quarrel, we no get such custom, and God assemblies no get am too.
But as I dey give una this command, I no praise una, say una dey come together no for better but for worse.
Because first of all, when una come together for di assembly, I hear say divisions dey among una, and I believe am for part.
Because factions must dey among una too, so that di people wey dem approve go dey revealed among una.
So when una gather together, no be di Lord supper una dey chop.
Because as una dey chop each one dey take im own supper first. One dey hungry, and another dey drunk.
Wetin, una no get houses to chop and to drink inside? Or una dey despise God assembly, and shame di people wey no get? Wetin I go tell una? I go praise una? For this I no praise una.
Because I receive from di Lord wetin I deliver to una too, say di Lord Jesus for di night wey dem betray am take bread.
When e don thank God, e break am talk say, “Take, chop. This na my body, wey dem break for una. Do this to remember me.”
Na so e take di cup too, after supper, talk say, “This cup na di new covenant for my blood. Do this, as often as una drink am, to remember me.”
Because as often as una chop this bread and drink this cup, una dey proclaim di Lord death until e come.
So whoever chop this bread or drink di Lord cup for unworthy way, go dey guilty of di body and di blood of di Lord.
But make man test imself, and so make e chop of di bread, and drink of di cup.
Because di one wey chop and drink for unworthy way dey chop and drink judgment for imself if e no discern di Lord body.
For this reason many among una weak and sickly, and no few sleep.
Because if we discern ourselves, dem no go judge us.
But when dem judge us, di Lord dey punish us, so that dem no go condemn us with di world.
So, my brothers, when una come together to chop, wait for each other.
But if anybody hungry, make e chop for house, so that una coming together no go result for judgment. Di rest I go arrange when I come.
Now about spiritual things, brothers, I no want make una no know.
Una know say when una be heathen, dem lead una go those idols wey no fit talk, however dem lead una.
So I make known to una say no man wey dey talk by God Spirit dey talk say, “Jesus dey accursed.” Nobody fit talk, “Jesus na Lord,” except by Holy Spirit.
Now different kinds of gifts dey, but di same Spirit.
Different kinds of service dey, and di same Lord.
Different kinds of workings dey, but di same God, wey dey work all things inside all.
But to each one dem dey give di manifestation of di Spirit for di profit of all.
Because to one dem dey give through di Spirit di word of wisdom, and to another di word of knowledge, according to di same Spirit;
to another faith, by di same Spirit; and to another gifts of healings, by di same Spirit;
and to another workings of miracles; and to another prophecy; and to another discernings of spirits; to another different kinds of languages; and to another di interpretation of languages.
But di one and di same Spirit dey work all of these, dey distribute to each one separately as e want.
Because as di body na one, and get many members, and all di members of di body, as dem plenty, na one body; na so Christ be too.
Because for one Spirit we all dem baptize into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether slaves or free; and dem make us all drink into one Spirit.
Because di body no be one member, but many.
If di foot talk, “Because I no be di hand, I no be part of di body,” e no mean say e no be part of di body.
If di ear talk, “Because I no be di eye, I no be part of di body,” e no mean say e no be part of di body.
If di whole body na eye, wia hearing go dey? If di whole na hearing, wia smelling go dey?
But now God don set di members, each one of dem, for di body, just as e want.
If dem all na one member, wia di body go dey?
But now dem be many members, but one body.
Di eye no fit tell di hand, “I no need you,” or di head to di feet again, “I no need una.”
No, much rather, those members of di body wey seem weaker na necessary.
Those parts of di body, wey we think say dem less honorable, on dem we dey give more honor; and our parts wey no fit show get more propriety;
while our parts wey fit show no need such. But God put di body together, dey give more honor to di part wey lack;
so that no division go dey for di body, but so that di members go get di same care for each other.
When one member suffer, all di members suffer with am. When dem honor one member, all di members rejoice with am.
Now una na di body of Christ, and members individually.
God don set some for di assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, den miracles, den gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages.
All na apostles? All na prophets? All na teachers? All dey do miracles?
All get gifts of healings? All dey talk with various languages? All dey interpret?
But earnestly desire di best gifts. Moreover, I go show una most excellent way.
If I talk with di languages of men and of angels, but I no get love, I don become sounding brass, or clanging cymbal.
If I get di gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge; and if I get all faith, so that I fit remove mountains, but I no get love, I be nothing.
If I give away all my goods to feed di poor, and if I give my body to burn, but I no get love, e profit me nothing.
Love dey patient and dey kind; love no dey envy. Love no dey brag, no dey proud,
no dey behave inappropriately, no dey seek im own way, no dey provoke easily, no dey keep account of evil;
no dey rejoice for unrighteousness, but dey rejoice with di truth;
dey bear all things, dey believe all things, dey hope all things, dey endure all things.
Love no dey fail ever. But wia prophecies dey, dem go end. Wia various languages dey, dem go stop. Wia knowledge dey, e go end.
Because we dey know for part, and we dey prophesy for part;
but when di one wey complete don come, den di one wey be part go end.
When I be pikin, I talk like pikin, I feel like pikin, I think like pikin. Now say I don become man, I don put away pikin things.
Because now we dey see for mirror, dimly, but den face to face. Now I know for part, but den I go know fully, even as dem don fully know me too.
But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. Di greatest of these na love.
Follow after love, and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but rather say una go prophesy.
Because di one wey dey talk another language no dey talk to men, but to God; because nobody dey understand; but for di Spirit e dey talk mysteries.
But di one wey dey prophesy dey talk to men for dem edification, exhortation, and consolation.
Di one wey dey talk another language dey edify imself, but di one wey dey prophesy dey edify di assembly.

Now I want make una all talk with other languages, but rather say una go prophesy. Because di one wey dey prophesy greater pass di one wey dey talk with other languages, unless e interpret, so that di assembly go receive edification.
But now, brothers, if I come to una dey talk with other languages, wetin I go profit una, unless I talk to una either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophesying, or of teaching?
Even things without life, wey dey give voice, whether pipe or harp, if dem no give distinction for di sounds, how dem go take know wetin dem dey play with pipe or harp?
Because if di trumpet give sound wey no clear, who go prepare imself for war?
So una too, unless una talk with di tongue words wey easy to understand, how dem go take know wetin dem talk? Because una go dey talk to di air.
E fit be say so many kinds of languages dey for di world, and none of dem no get meaning.
So if I no know di meaning of di language, I go be foreigner to di one wey dey talk, and di one wey dey talk go be foreigner to me.
So una too, since una zealous for spiritual gifts, seek say una go abound for di building up of di assembly.
So make di one wey dey talk another language pray say e go fit interpret.
Because if I pray for another language, my spirit dey pray, but my understanding no dey bear fruit.
Wetin den? I go pray with di spirit, and I go pray with di understanding too. I go sing with di spirit, and I go sing with di understanding too.
If no be so if you bless with di spirit, how di one wey dey di place of di person wey no get di gift go talk di “Amen” when you dey thank God, as e no know wetin you talk?
Because you dey thank God well well, but di other person no dey build up.
I thank my God, I dey talk with other languages pass una all.
But for di assembly I go prefer to talk five words with my understanding, so that I go teach others too, than 10,000 words for another language.
Brothers, no be pikin dem for thoughts, but for malice be babies, but for thoughts be mature.
For di law e dey write, “By men wey get strange languages and by di lips of strangers I go talk to this people. Even so dem no go hear me, di Lord talk.”
So languages na for sign, no to di people wey believe, but to di unbelieving; but prophesying na for sign, no to di unbelieving, but to di people wey believe.
So if di whole assembly gather together and all dey talk with other languages, and unlearned or unbelieving people come in, dem no go talk say una don craze?
But if all dey prophesy, and unbelieving or unlearned person come in, all go reprove am, and all go judge am.
And so di secrets of im heart go dey revealed. So e go fall down on im face worship God, dey declare say God dey among una truly.
Wetin den, brothers? When una come together, each one get psalm, get teaching, get revelation, get language, get interpretation. Make all things dey done to build each other up.
If any man dey talk another language, make e be two, or at most three, and one by one; and make one interpret.
But if interpreter no dey, make e keep quiet for di assembly, and make e talk to imself, and to God.
Make two or three prophets talk, and make di others discern.
But if dem make revelation to another person wey dey sit near, make di first keep quiet.
Because una all fit prophesy one by one, so that all go learn, and all go dey encouraged.
Di spirits of di prophets dey subject to di prophets,
because God no be God of confusion, but of peace, as for all di assemblies of di saints.
Make una women keep quiet for di assemblies, because dem no allow dem to talk; but make dem dey subject, as di law talk too.
If dem want learn anything, make dem ask dem own husbands for house, because e shameful for woman to chatter for di assembly.
Wetin? E come from una say God word go out? Or e come to una alone?
If any man think say e be prophet, or spiritual, make e recognize di things wey I write to una, say na di Lord commandment.
But if anybody no know, make e no know.
So, brothers, desire earnestly to prophesy, and no forbid talking with other languages.
Make all things dey done decently and in order.
Now I make known to una, brothers, di Good News wey I preach to una, wey una receive too, wey una dey stand for,
by which dem dey save una too, if una hold di word wey I preach to una firm—unless una believe for nothing.
Because I deliver to una first of all wetin I receive too: say Christ die for our sins according to di Scriptures,
and say dem bury am, and say dem raise am for di third day according to di Scriptures,
and say e appear to Cephas, den to di 12.
Den e appear to pass 500 brothers at once, most of dem still dey until now, but some don sleep too.
Den e appear to James, den to all di apostles,
and last of all, as to di child wey dem born for wrong time, e appear to me too.
Because I be di least of di apostles, wey no worthy to dem call apostle, because I persecute di assembly of God.
But by di grace of God I be wetin I be. Im grace wey dem give me no be for nothing, but I work more pass all of dem; yet no be me, but di grace of God wey dey with me.
So whether na me or dem, na so we preach, and na so una believe.
Now if dem dey preach Christ say dem don raise am from di dead, how some among una take dey talk say resurrection of di dead no dey?
But if resurrection of di dead no dey, dem no raise Christ too.
If dem no raise Christ, den our preaching na for nothing, and una faith na for nothing too.
Yes, dem find us false witnesses of God, because we testify about God say e raise up Christ, wey e no raise up, if e be say dem no dey raise di dead.
Because if dem no dey raise di dead, dem no raise Christ too.
If dem no raise Christ, una faith dey useless; una still dey for una sins.
Den di people wey don sleep for Christ don perish too.
If na only for this life we don hope for Christ, we pity pass all men.
But now dem don raise Christ from di dead. E become di first fruits of di people wey don sleep.
Because since death come by man, resurrection of di dead come by man too.
Because as for Adam all dey die, na so for Christ all go dey made alive.
But each for im own order: Christ di first fruits, den di people wey be Christ own, for im coming.
Den di end go come, when e go deliver up di Kingdom to God, even Papa God; when e don abolish all rule and all authority and power.
Because e must rule until e don put all im enemies under im feet.
Di last enemy wey dem go abolish na death.
Because, “E put all things under im feet.” But when e talk, “Dem don put all things under am,” e clear say di one wey put all things under am no dey among dem.
When dem don put all things under am, den di Pikin imself go dey under di one wey put all things under am, so that God go be all inside all.
Or if no be so wetin di people wey dem baptize for di dead go do? If dem no dey raise di dead at all, why den dem dey baptize dem for dem?
Why we dey stand for danger every hour too?
I affirm, by di boasting for una wey I get for Christ Jesus our Lord, I dey die every day.
If I fight with animals for Ephesus for human purposes, wetin I gain? If dem no dey raise di dead, “make we chop and drink, because tomorrow we go die.”
No dey deceived. “Bad friends dey spoil good character.”
Wake up righteously, and no sin; because some no get knowledge of God. I talk this to shame una.
But somebody go talk, “How dem dey raise di dead?” and “Wetin kind body dem dey come with?”
You foolish one, wetin you yourself plant no dey come alive unless e die.
Wetin you plant, no be di body wey go dey you dey plant, but bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.
But God dey give am body as e please am, and to each seed body of im own.
All flesh no be di same flesh, but one flesh dey of men, another flesh of animals, another of fish, and another of birds.
Heavenly bodies dey too, and earthly bodies; but di glory of di heavenly na one, and di glory of di earthly na another.
One glory dey of di sun, another glory of di moon, and another glory of di stars; because one star dey different from another star for glory.
Na so di resurrection of di dead be too. Dem dey plant di body wey go perish; dem dey raise am wey no go perish.
Dem dey plant am for dishonor; dem dey raise am for glory. Dem dey plant am for weakness; dem dey raise am for power.
Dem dey plant natural body; dem dey raise spiritual body. Natural body dey and spiritual body dey too.
So e dey write too, “Di first man, Adam, become living soul.” Di last Adam become life-giving spirit.
But wetin spiritual no be first, but wetin natural, den wetin spiritual.
Di first man come from di earth, dem make am from dust. Di second man na di Lord from heaven.
As di one wey dem make from dust dey, na so di people wey dem make from dust be; and as di heavenly dey, na so di people wey be heavenly be too.
As we don carry di image of di people wey dem make from dust, make we carry di image of di heavenly too.
Now I talk this, brothers, say flesh and blood no fit inherit God Kingdom; and wetin dey perish no fit inherit wetin no dey perish.
Look, I dey tell una mystery. We no go all sleep, but we go all change,
for one moment, for di twinkling of eye, for di last trumpet. Because di trumpet go sound, and dem go raise di dead wey no go decay, and we go change.
Because this body wey dey perish must become wetin no dey perish, and this mortal must put on immortality.
But when this body wey dey perish don become wetin no dey perish, and this mortal don become immortal, den wetin dem write go happen: “Death don swallow up for victory.”
“Death, wia your sting dey? Hades, wia your victory dey?”
Di sting of death na sin, and di power of sin na di law.
But thanks be to God, wey dey give us di victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
So, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always dey abound for di Lord work, as una know say una labor no be for nothing for di Lord.
Now about di collection for di saints, as I give order to di assemblies of Galatia, una do di same.
For di first day of every week, make each one of una save, as e prosper, so that dem no go make collections when I come.
When I reach, I go send whoever una approve with letters to carry una gracious gift go Jerusalem.
If e appropriate for me to go too, dem go go with me.
But I go come to una when I don pass through Macedonia, because I dey pass through Macedonia.
But with una e fit be say I go stay, or even spend winter, so that una go send me on my way wherever I go.
Because I no wish to see una now as I dey pass, but I hope to stay small time with una, if di Lord permit.
But I go stay for Ephesus until Pentecost,
because great and effective door don open to me, and many adversaries dey.
Now if Timothy come, make sure say e dey with una without fear, because e dey do di work of di Lord, as I dey do too.
So make nobody despise am. But send am forward on im journey in peace, so that e go come to me; because I dey expect am with di brothers.
But about Apollos di brother, I strongly urge am to come to una with di brothers; and e no want come now at all; but e go come when e get opportunity.
Watch! Stand firm for di faith! Be courageous! Be strong!
Make all wey una do dey done for love.
Now I beg una, brothers—una know di house of Stephanas, say na di first fruits of Achaia, and say dem don set demself to serve di saints—
say una too dey subject to such people, and to everybody wey dey help for di work and dey labor.
I rejoice for di coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus; because wetin una lack, dem supply am.
Because dem refresh my spirit and una own. So acknowledge di people wey be like that.
Di assemblies of Asia dey greet una. Aquila and Priscilla dey greet una well well for di Lord, together with di assembly wey dey dem house.
All di brothers dey greet una. Greet each other with holy kiss.
This greeting na by me, Paul, with my own hand.
If any man no love di Lord Jesus Christ, make e dey accursed. Come, Lord!
Di grace of di Lord Jesus Christ dey with una.
My love dey with una all for Christ Jesus. Amen.
